name: courtroom-arena
description: A portfolio project inspired by [adalat.ai](https://www.adalat.ai/)'s courtroom-automation space — but instead of replicating their real product (transcription/case-flow tools sold to actual courts), this is a **simulation engine**: two adversarial AI agents (Prosecution vs Defense) argue a *fictional/hypothetical* case in front of an AI Judge agent, with a live transcript and a waiting-room dashboard showing pending simulated cases.
